title: NestJS GraphQL Application Structure
abstract: File-placement and anatomy guide for NestJS GraphQL applications, designed for AI agents and LLMs. Teaches where every file belongs in a feature-first, code-first codebase — the base structure map plus per-file rules for modules, services, resolvers, inputs, entities, repositories, loaders, events, auth, exceptions, pagination, subscriptions, providers, background jobs, scalars, and seeds — each with purpose, responsibilities, and incorrect-vs-correct examples. It also covers how modules connect to resolve GraphQL fields and relations, including module-resolution concerns such as circular dependencies, while deferring behavioral concerns to the nestjs-best-practices skill.
